scenes.text:
DECEMBER 1986. 1:15 AM.

Omnidyne Tower. Forty floors of black glass downtown, and three more underground that aren't on any blueprint.

You've spent two weeks with a city directory, a scanner radio and a lot of coffee. The tower runs its doors, lifts and cameras from a facilities computer that dials out to a contractor every night at 1 AM.

Tonight, you'll be the one on the other end of that call.

mission.title: Night Shift
mission.brief: Get into Omnidyne Tower's facilities computer. Read the night guard roster so you know when sub-level 3 is quiet, and download the floor plan for the sub-levels. The facilities box uses an old combination-dial lock.

10.40.0.7.name: OMNI-FACILITIES
10.40.0.7.banner: OMNIDYNE TOWER // BUILDING SERVICES // AFTER-HOURS MODE

files.guard_roster.txt:

files.sublevels.plan:
SL1  archive
SL2  backup power, BASILISK core servers (OMNI-CORE)
SL3  'secure accommodation' - 4 rooms, door controller SL3-DOORS

scenes.speaker: SYSTEM
scenes.text:
2:00 AM. The sub-level 3 desk goes quiet for twenty minutes.

Your modem has two lines tonight. One reaches the SL3 door controller. The other reaches OMNI-CORE, the machine running BASILISK itself.

There may only be time for one of them before someone notices.

options.label: Both. Open CASSANDRA's door AND wipe BASILISK.
options.text: Greedy. Maybe stupid. But you might never get this close again.

options.label: Just the door. Get CASSANDRA out.

mission.title: Twenty Minutes
mission.brief: Two targets, one window. Upload release.cmd to the SL3 door controller to open CASSANDRA's room, and delete basilisk_core.db from OMNI-CORE. The core has a memory-pattern lock. The door controller has an override code somewhere in your notes.

10.40.2.9.name: OMNI-CORE
10.40.2.9.banner: BASILISK CORE // PHASE 2 STATUS: DEGRADED (SIGNAL NOISE AT HOLLOW CREEK)

files.director_memo.txt: The Hollow Creek noise is deliberate. Find the person who did it. Priority one.

mission.title: Room 303
mission.brief: One target. Upload release.cmd to the SL3 door controller to open CASSANDRA's room. The controller has an override code somewhere in your notes.

scenes.speaker: CASSANDRA
scenes.text:
3:40 AM. Your private line rings.

"{handle}. It's me. I'm out. I walked straight up the fire stairs while every screen on SL2 went red.

You deleted the core. Four thousand names, gone. They'll rebuild it, but it'll take them a year.

They also know someone did it on purpose now. They'll come looking."

scenes.speaker: CASSANDRA
scenes.text:
3:40 AM. Your private line rings.

"{handle}. It's me. I'm out. The door just... opened. I didn't wait to ask why.

BASILISK is still running. But we're both alive, and I know things about it now that nobody outside that building does."

scenes.speaker: CASSANDRA
scenes.text:
"My name is Dr. Elena Voss. I designed BASILISK. When I found out what Phase 3 was for, I tried to quit. They didn't let me.

There's a copy of the full Phase 3 plan. Not at the tower. At a government data centre in the mountains, somewhere called SITE NINE.

Get some sleep. Then upgrade that rig of yours. Where we're going next doesn't use dial-up locks."

END OF CHAPTER 3

CASSANDRA is free. SITE NINE is waiting. Chapter 4 is coming.

New contracts are up on the Job Board.
